name: Mount Kenya: Sirimon route to Point Lenana
why: Up the dry Sirimon valley of giant lobelias to Shipton's Camp under the rock spires of Batian and Nelion, sunrise on Point Lenana, then down past Lake Michaelson in the Gorges Valley.
book: Kenya Wildlife Service park fees; a registered guide and porters through an operator in Nanyuki or Chogoria.
dangers: Ice on the final slope in the early morning.
Hail and rain in the afternoons.
turnaround: Leave Shipton's at 02:30; turn back at 07:00 wherever you are.

points.name: Sirimon Gate
points.note: The park gate on the dry north-west side.

points.name: Old Moses Camp
points.note: Huts at 3,300 m at the edge of the moorland.

points.name: Shipton's Camp
points.note: Huts at 4,200 m right under Batian and Nelion.

points.name: Point Lenana
points.note: The trekkers' summit, 4,985 m, above the Lewis glacier.

points.name: Lake Michaelson
points.note: A dark lake under cliffs at the head of the Gorges Valley.
